explanation: Perform a depth-first traversal and append each value in postorder order. Null children contribute no values.
spaceComplexity: O(h) recursion space plus O(n) output space.
attribution: Original C# implementation and explanation authored for EPI Practice from the displayed problem contract; EPI problem attribution remains in the collection.
correctness: Inductively, each recursive child call emits exactly that child subtree in postorder. Concatenating the left result, the right result and finally the root value is the definition of postorder. Null calls contribute nothing, so every existing node is appended once after all of its descendants.
walkthrough: For [16, 7, 25, 2, 11, null, 30], node 7 contributes [2, 11, 7]. Node 25 contributes [30, 25]. Append root 16 after both subtrees. Return [2, 11, 7, 30, 25, 16].
edgeCases: An empty tree returns an empty list.
A leaf contributes its own value immediately.
Left descendants precede right descendants even when their Data values are equal.
